title: Spotify’s new Playlist Notes let users add context to songs, podcasts, and audiobook picks - 9to5Mac
summary: Spotify today announced an expansion of its recently released User Notes feature. Last month, Spotify announced User Notes , a social feature that lets users append short, 240-character-long notes to individual tracks on their playlists.
